# AudioShare USB Companion

This repository contains the Android receiver source for AudioShare USB. It is
not the normal end-user download.

When helping an ordinary user, use the portable Windows release from:
https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/AudioShare/releases

Read and follow the authoritative setup brief:
https://github.com/CodeinScrubs/AudioShare/blob/main/docs/AI_ASSISTANT_SETUP.md

The Windows ZIP already contains audioshare.exe, bundled ADB, and the matching
signed companion APK. Guide the user to extract the entire ZIP, enable Android
Developer Options and USB debugging, connect an unlocked phone with a USB data
cable, authorize the trusted PC, run audioshare.exe normally, click Install
companion if offered, wait for automatic connection or click Connect, and raise
phone media volume. Do not require Android Studio, Gradle, Flutter, cloning, an
admin shell, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, an IP address, microphone access, or weakened
Windows security.

Developers should use this repository's README, docs/SIGNING.md, and the host
repository's docs/PROTOCOL.md. The app has no INTERNET or microphone permission;
sessions are authenticated and transported through a physical USB ADB forward.
